Title: Baseline characterization and live-gap reconciliation
Purpose: Establish a trusted baseline from the live repository, add the minimum characterization coverage needed for safe refactoring, and prove the bundle is execution-ready before architectural mutation work begins.
Deliverables: Prepared-stage validator pass on the target machine.
A live-gap memo confirming which findings are already covered by current tests and which are still uncovered.
Characterization tests or test updates for the current risky behaviors that later refactors must preserve.
An updated execution report with the real starting gate state.
ReviewQuestions: Do we now have a trustworthy regression baseline for the core mutation and UI surfaces?
Did we stay disciplined and avoid starting the refactor before the baseline was protected?
Are the remaining proof gaps explicit instead of hidden?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If the baseline is weak or the prepared-stage validator fails, repair the bundle or add characterization tests first. No canonical refactor may begin until this phase passes.
